help.title: Help
help.exit_text:
To avoid accidents, you have to press twice to exit:
• Controller: press START and SELECT together (on an Xbox controller these are the ☰ and ⧉ buttons). The screen shows "Press again to quit..."; press once more.
• Keyboard: press Esc twice in a row.
If you pressed only once by mistake, just keep playing; the message goes away after a few seconds.
Game Center comes back by itself after you exit. Your progress is saved whenever you save inside the game, just like on the real console.
help.play_text:
1. Click "Open games folder" and copy your games into it. All in one place is fine; Game Center recognizes the console by itself.
2. New games show up after a few seconds (or click "Look for new games").
3. Select a game and click "Play" (or press A on the controller).
help.pad_title: Using Game Center with a controller
help.pad_text:
• Up / Down: choose a game
• A: play
• LB / RB: switch list (All, PS1, SNES...)
• Y: add / remove favorite
• X: more options (rename, open folder...)
• START: settings   • SELECT: help
• B: close window
help.disc_text:
When the game asks you to "insert disc 2":
1. Open the menu: press both analog sticks in at the same time (L3 + R3), or press F1.
2. Choose "Disc Control".
3. Choose "Eject Disc" → at "Current Disc Index" pick the next disc → choose "Insert Disc".
4. Press L3 + R3 (or F1) again to go back to the game.
Your progress is kept.
help.ps2_text:
• A BIOS is required: back up (dump) the BIOS from your own PS2 and copy it into the BIOS folder. Straight into the BIOS folder is fine; Game Center sorts it out. The file name does not matter (usually SCPH-xxxxx.bin, 4 MB). If you also have .rom1, .rom2, .erom or .nvm files with the same name, copy them too.
• Formats: .iso, .chd, .cso, .zso, or .bin + .cue for CD games. Game Center tells PS1 and PS2 discs apart by their content. Only PS2 CD games compressed to .chd need to go in the Games\PS2 folder.
• PS2 needs a fairly powerful computer (4 CPU cores and a dedicated or recent built-in graphics chip are recommended).
• A controller with two analog sticks is recommended, because many PS2 games need them.
• PS2 memory cards are included when you click "Back up saves".
help.bios_text:
PS1 games play right away without a BIOS.
PS2 games need the BIOS of a PS2 console (see the PlayStation 2 section above).
For better compatibility, you can add BIOS files that you legally backed up from your own console to the BIOS folder. Game Center does not provide or download BIOS files.
help.errors_text: Game Center records errors in the Logs folder. If you need help, send the gamecenter.log file from that folder.
